title: Sunday Quick Tip
subtitle: Plan before you park
hook: Do you know your first drill before you get out of the car?
intro: You arrive with a bag of balls and an hour.
The plan is in your head, mostly.
statement: A written plan frees you to watch the kids.
q1: Do you write out every drill and time —
q2: or keep a loose plan and adjust as you go?
q3: How much of practice do you spend deciding what is next?
t1: Every coach is different. But practice flows
t2: when the next drill is already decided.
cta: Coaches — how do you plan practice?
ctaLines: Index card. Phone note. Three drills and a game.
ctaPrompt: Share your planning habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Do you know your first drill before you get out of the car?
You arrive with a bag of balls and an hour. The plan is in your head, mostly.
A written plan frees you to watch the kids.
A written plan or a flexible outline. There is no perfect answer.
How do you plan practice? Share your habit in the comments.
